title: Across wellness visit status
one_line_definition: Displays the distribution of targeted care gaps segmented by whether members have completed, scheduled, or never had a wellness visit. Answers 'Across which wellness visit status do the most targeted gaps remain open?'
result_meaning: [{"pattern": "Majority of targeted gaps fall in the 'No Wellness Visit' slice (>60%)", "interpretation": "Members without any wellness visit represent the highest-risk, lowest-touch population, signaling an urgent outreach priority to close both visit and coding gaps simultaneously."}, {"pattern": "Gaps are roughly equal between 'No Wellness Visit' and 'Wellness Visit Completed' slices", "interpretation": "A large share of gaps persisting even after completed visits indicates documentation or coding deficiencies during the encounter, requiring provider education on thorough HCC capture."}, {"pattern": "'Wellness Visit Scheduled' slice holds a significant portion of targeted gaps", "interpretation": "A substantial pipeline of upcoming visits presents a near-term opportunity to close gaps proactively by equipping care teams with pre-visit gap summaries before appointments occur."}]
